abilities.name: All Schemes to Know

_curatorNotes: icdGate 'none' authored 2026-08-18 (coordinated-attack round): gcsim's ICDGroupNahidaSkill is a 60f timer and Tri-Karma's own 2.5s trigger interval is 150f, so the counter has always reset before the next proc and every one applies at the group's 1.5 multiplier. ⚠️ Authored rather than left absent because absent now means STANDARD ICD for a proc; the behaviour is unchanged, the claim is now explicit.

behavior changed from 'stance' to 'instant': Nahida's E does not replace normals/charge for any duration. The Seed of Skandha mark (1500 frames = 25s) is applied to enemies, not a caster-side entity — omitted from summons[]. Top-level duration: 25 removed; it was the enemy debuff lifetime, not an ability-side duration.

Tri-Karma Purification: MODELLED 2026-08-17 as a damage effect on an onReaction trigger with an application[] — the fourth source that reaches the gauge (docs/mark-triggered-damage-round.md). source 'team' because gcsim subscribes to every reaction event with no actor filter (nahida.go Init, ReactionEventStartDelim loop) and to OnEnemyDamage filtered to Bloom/Burgeon/Hyperbloom, both of which our 'any' covers. armedFor 25 is the Seed of Skandha's lifetime (skill.go skillMarkKey, 1500 frames); the Seed is a state on the ENEMY, so it is deliberately not a summons[] entry and not an activeDuration. procCooldown 2.5 is triKarmaInterval's base.

Tri-Karma applies 1.5U, the corpus's first. skill.go writes Durability: 25, but ICDGroupNahidaSkill's sequence is {1.5, 0, 0, …} on a 1s timer (pkg/core/attacks/icd_groups.dm.go) and pkg/enemy/attack.go multiplies incoming durability by that entry — so a proc lands at 37.5 durability. With a 2.5s trigger interval the group never binds, so every proc is 1.5U. Application frame 3 = QueueAttackWithSnap's delay argument. Values at talent 10: triKarmaAtk[9]=1.8576, triKarmaEM[9]=3.7152, matching the sidecar's "185.8% ATK+371.5% Elemental Mastery".

NOT modelled, each for a stated reason. (1) The burst's trigger-interval reduction (burstTriKarmaCDReduction, -0.446s per Electro teammate at talent 10, only inside Shrine of Maya): procCooldown has no conditional form, and measured on the oracle fixtures the interval is never the binding constraint — observed gaps are 4.9-5.6s against a 2.5s floor. (2) C6 Karmic Oblivion, a second Tri-Karma at 200% ATK + 400% EM on a 0.2s ICD, six per burst: it is gated on an on-field state (c6ActiveKey) the parser does not track. (3) The proc does not enter the finalize hit stream, so it does not trigger Deepwood or any other artifact onHit set — true in game, and its own landing.

Inherited trigger: 'manual' on effects (effects[] is empty here). Underlying Tri-Karma proc: likely onReaction with Seed of Skandha condition + onDmg for bloom-type AttackTags. Target scope: all Seed-marked enemies (multi-target AoE on the skill mark group).

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — Sentence 1 describes the modelled 2.5s procCooldown — working behavior. The Electro-teammate interval reduction changes nothing on screen: the character's own curator note measures observed reaction gaps of 4.9–5.6s against a 2.5s floor, so the interval is never the binding constraint and no extra pip would ever draw. The C6 half would only add applications to the aura lane (OFF by default) / aura log (an opt-in aside), and it is authored on the BASE skill so it also shows at C0 where it is irrelevant. Tri-Karma is an onReaction proc, not summon-hosted, so it produces no summon-lane tick markers and no bar at all on the default timeline. Category: working-behavior.

variants.label: Hold
_curatorNotes: Hold E has parametric total frame count: Frames(next) = hold + skillHoldFrames[next], where hold = max(min(p['hold'], 300), 1) - 1 ∈ [0, 299]. Frames recorded above are at min-hold (hold=0). At max-hold (hold=299): swap=356, N=356, Q=361, D=358, J=361.

cooldownStartDelay for Hold variant is parametric: hold + 30 frames. At min-hold (hold=0): 30 frames. At max-hold (hold=299): 329 frames. AbilityVariant has no cooldownStartDelay schema field — reviewer to decide whether to extend the schema or model only the min-hold value.

abilities.description:
Sends forth karmic bonds of wood and tree from her side, dealing AoE Dendro DMG and marking up to 8 opponents hit with the Seed of Skandha.
When held, this skill will trigger differently.

Hold
Enters Aiming Mode, which will allow you to select a limited number of opponents within a limited area. During this time, Nahida's resistance to interruption will be increased.
When released, this skill deals Dendro DMG to these opponents and marks them with the Seed of Skandha.
Aiming Mode will last up to 5s and can select a maximum of 8 opponents.

Seed of Skandha
Opponents who have been marked by the Seed of Skandha will be linked to one another up till a certain distance.
After you trigger Elemental Reactions on opponents who are affected by the Seeds of Skandha or when they take DMG from Dendro Cores (including Burgeon and Hyperbloom DMG), Nahida will unleash Tri-Karma Purification on the opponents and all connected opponents, dealing Dendro DMG based on her ATK and Elemental Mastery.
You can trigger at most 1 Tri-Karma Purification within a short period of time.

abilities.name: Illusory Heart
_curatorNotes: Shrine of Maya party-composition-dependent buffs not authored: (a) Pyro — while Nahida is within the field, Tri-Karma Purification DMG is increased (gcsim: burstTriKarmaDmgBonus[pyroCount-1][talentLevel] added as AttackMod on each 30-frame tick); (b) Electro — Tri-Karma Purification ICD interval reduced by burstTriKarmaCDReduction[electroCount-1][talentLevel]; (c) Hydro — field duration extended (AUTHORED 2026-09-17, see the summon's durationModifiers and the note below). All branch values require talent-level lookup tables; effects[] skeleton not authored — needs reviewer pass.

↻ HYDRO EXTENSION AUTHORED 2026-09-17 (T1 tranche) as two mutually exclusive `durationModifiers` on the summon: +6.0192s with one Hydro party member and +9.0288s with two (gcsim `burst.go` `dur += burstTriKarmaDurationExtend[hydroCount-1][TalentLvlBurst]`, `zz_nahida.dm.go` rows at index 9 = TL10), `hydroCount` capped at 2 and raised by 1 at C1 (`cons.go` c1). So: 0 Hydro → 15s (21.02s at C1), 1 → 21.02s (24.03s at C1), 2 → 24.03s. The old note said no condition could express it; `applyModifiers` has carried team scope since 2026-08-18. Measured before: `Nahida E Q > Xingqiu E Q` drew the Shrine 15s in the Hydro-bloom team, 6s short.
nonHitting (non-hitting casts round, 2026-09-16 (docs/nonhitting-casts-round.md §1)): gcsim nahida/burst.go: the buff field only, no QueueAttack.
abilities.description:
Manifests the Court of Dreams and expands the Shrine of Maya.

When the Shrine of Maya field is unleashed, the following effects will be separately unleashed based on the Elemental Types present within the party.
·Pyro: While Nahida remains within the Shrine of Maya, the DMG dealt by Tri-Karma Purification from "All Schemes to Know" is increased.
·Electro: While Nahida remains within the Shrine of Maya, the interval between each Tri-Karma Purification from "All Schemes to Know" is decreased.
·Hydro: The Shrine of Maya's duration is increased.

If there are at least 2 party members of the aforementioned Elemental Types present when the field is deployed, the aforementioned effects will be increased further.

Even if Nahida is not on the field, these bonuses will still take effect so long as party members are within the Shrine of Maya.

passives.name: Compassion Illuminated
_curatorNotes: 2026-05-14 (canonicalAssumption primitive): consolidated 2 generator-artifact effects → 1 buff effect at the canonical-rotation peak. Real mechanic: +25% of the highest-EM teammate's EM granted to the active character in Shrine of Maya, cap +250 EM. Canonical assumption: Nahida is built to 1000+ EM (canonical Dendro investment), so 25% × 1000 = +250 EM → caps at +250. peer-stat-routing isn't expressible in the schema (would need a `highestTeamStat` BuffValue variant), so `value` is plain 250 + canonicalAssumption headlineValue=250 makes the assumption explicit. gcsim: calcA1Buff() at Q cast + applyA1() per 30-frame tick — modeled as onCast burst buffs lasting the Shrine's length plus 1s (see the effect note).

↻ 2026-09-17 (T1 tranche): THREE mutually exclusive copies, one per Shrine of Maya length (15 / 21.02 / 24.03s by Hydro count, C1 adding one) — an Effect has no durationModifiers, so condition-gated duplicates are the wired expression (Faruzan's C2 pair). Each is the field's length PLUS 1s: gcsim `applyA1(60)` re-grants a 60-frame EM mod on every 30f field tick through the field's last frame, so the bonus outlives the Shrine by 1s — authored at its honest length per Nate's 2026-09-15 ruling.

⚠️⚠️ ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING: the active-target pool keeps the FIRST surviving effect per `stat`, so the gated copies come first and the UNCONDITIONED 15+1s copy last, as the else-branch. It is unconditioned on purpose — A1 always applies at one of the three lengths, and a gate on every copy made the Team Builder mark the +250 EM as team-conditional. ⚠️ Safe only because `teamElementCount` resolves definitively on the received surface (fixed the same day); in a context that cannot resolve it, the 2-Hydro copy survives and the bar reads long.

passives.description:
When unleashing Illusory Heart, the Shrine of Maya will gain the following effects:
The Elemental Mastery of the active character within the field will be increased by 25% of the Elemental Mastery of the party member with the highest Elemental Mastery.
You can gain a maximum of 250 Elemental Mastery in this manner.
passives.caveat: Assumes a 1000+ EM build (canonical Dendro investment). Shown at the +250 EM cap; in game it's 25% of the highest-EM party member's EM, and in canonical play the caster is that member — reaching the cap.

passives.name: Awakening Elucidated
_curatorNotes: 2026-05-14 (canonicalAssumption primitive): consolidated 3 generator-artifact effects → 2 buff effects at the canonical-rotation peak. Real mechanic: per-EM-threshold scaling on Nahida's own EM — (EM - 200) × 0.1% Tri-Karma DMG, cap +80%; (EM - 200) × 0.03% Tri-Karma CR, cap +24%. Canonical assumption: Nahida built to 1000+ EM → both caps reached. The per-EM-with-offset scaling isn't expressible in the existing `scaling` BuffValue (no offset support), and per-abilityName-filtered routing isn't a primitive yet, so authored as plain caps + canonicalAssumption. CR component uses global `critRate`; in-game it's scoped to Tri-Karma Purification only — caveat documents the over-render. gcsim: AddAttackMod permanent (-1) duration recalculated every 30f via a4Tick(); modeled here as `trigger: passive` (always-on while ascension≥1).

[A7] Effect stat is skillDmgBonus, scoped in-game to Tri-Karma Purification only; since that is her only skill, the global skill-DMG buff is functionally correct for this self-targeted buff (no over-render on this effect).

[A7] Over-render of the global critRate stat is pending the deferred per-abilityName-filtered routing primitive; Ayato C1 shares the same gap. In game the CR is correct on Tri-Karma Purification and over-stated on all other hits.
[cA-fold 2026-07-20] canonicalAssumption removed (type retired); its assumption text folded into the ability-level caveat. headlineValue equaled value (80).
[cA-fold 2026-07-20] canonicalAssumption removed (type retired); its assumption text folded into the ability-level caveat. headlineValue equaled value (24).

passives.description:
Each point of Nahida's Elemental Mastery beyond 200 will grant 0.1% Bonus DMG and 0.03% CRIT Rate to Tri-Karma Purification from All Schemes to Know.
A maximum of 80% Bonus DMG and 24% CRIT Rate can be granted to Tri-Karma Purification in this manner.
passives.caveat: Assumes a 1000+ EM build: the +80% skill DMG and +24% CRIT Rate caps (each scaling per EM above 200) are shown reached. The CRIT Rate is also shown on every hit; in game it applies to Tri-Karma Purification only.

constellations.name: The Seed of Stored Knowledge
_curatorNotes: No effects[] authored for C1. gcsim c1() increments pyroCount, electroCount, and hydroCount each by 1 at init, capped at 2. Effect: Shrine of Maya (Illusory Heart) behaves as if the party has one additional Pyro, Electro, and Hydro character simultaneously — unlocking or upgrading all three element-specific buffs. Not representable as a standard effect skeleton; reviewer to decide how to model this team-composition modifier. ↻ 2026-09-17: the HYDRO half is modelled — the Shrine's durationModifiers and A1's three copies count C1 as one more Hydro member. The Pyro (Tri-Karma DMG, magnitude) and Electro (Tri-Karma interval, which never binds on measured reaction gaps) halves stay unauthored.
constellations.description: When the Shrine of Maya is unleashed and the Elemental Types of the party members are being tabulated, the count will add 1 to the number of Pyro, Electro, and Hydro characters respectively.

constellations.name: The Root of All Fullness
_curatorNotes: Effect values wrong: gcsim C2 sets CR += 0.2 (+20% CRIT Rate) and CD = 1.0 (sets CRIT DMG to 100%, not adds) for Burning/Bloom/Hyperbloom/Burgeon/BountifulCore on Seed-marked enemies. Skeleton has value: 10 for both CR and CD — both are incorrect. Correct values: CR=20, CD=100.

Lunar-Bloom variant not authored: gcsim also handles AttackTagDirectLunarBloom separately (CR += 0.1, CD += 0.2 — additive, not set). This +10% CR and +20% CD for Lunar-Bloom is completely absent from the skeleton.

DEF shred authored (capability sweep 2026-07-28): gcsim internal/characters/nahida/cons.go:53-71 — AddDefMod -0.3, 480f = 8s, fired on event.OnQuicken/OnAggravate/OnSpread from any team member against Seed-marked enemies. Seed-of-Skandha enemy-mark state is not trackable; effect is unconditioned per the Citlali/Chevreuse/Durin onReaction-resShred precedent (Seeds are up whenever E has run) — Seed scope caveated on the ability.

↻ RETIRED 2026-09-17 (T1 tranche, `manual` retirement): the two `manual` critRate 20 / critDmg 100 effects are deleted. They never drew (no surface reads `manual`) and were mis-shaped besides — self buffs standing in for an ENEMY-side property (reaction DMG can crit against Seed-marked opponents), so re-triggering them would have drawn a false +20% CRIT Rate bar on Nahida. Reaction CRIT is damage magnitude with no pixel. The prior values and the Lunar-Bloom half stay recorded in the notes above.

A6 rigor 2026-07-12: critRate value corrected 10 → 20, critDmg value corrected 10 → 100 (in-JSON description 'fixed at 20% and 100%' + gcsim cons.go c2(): CR += 0.2, CD = 1). Targeting/trigger rework (should be enemy reaction-crit, not self buff) and missing Lunar-Bloom effect still pending per notes above.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — The −30% DEF debuff bar. The resShred is deliberately authored unconditioned (the Seed mark is enemy state we cannot track), so the bar draws off any team Quicken/Aggravate/Spread — including a rotation where Nahida never casts E, or one where a teammate reacts on an unmarked target. The current wording reads as pure kit explanation and never says the bar is what is over-claiming; the rewrite names it. Placement on the C2 entry is correct — it is gated to readers who have C2. Category: approximation-disclosure.
constellations.description:
Opponents that are marked by Seeds of Skandha applied by Nahida herself will be affected by the following effects:
· Burning, Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon Reaction DMG they receive can score CRIT Hits. CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG are fixed at 20% and 100% respectively. CRIT Rate from this effect stacks with CRIT Rate from similar effects that allow these Elemental Reactions to CRIT.
· Within 8s of being affected by Quicken, Aggravate, or Spread, DEF is decreased by 30%.
· The CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG of Lunar-Bloom DMG received are increased by 10% and 20% respectively.

constellations.name: The Stem of Manifest Inference
_curatorNotes: Stack-dependent EM buff: gcsim c4() uses AddStatMod with permanent (-1) duration; the Amount function counts enemies within 30-radius with Seed of Skandha and returns EM = 80 + count*20 (count capped at 4). Full range: 1 enemy → 100 EM, 2 → 120, 3 → 140, 4+ → 160. Skeleton value: 100 is the 1-enemy minimum only. Not representable as a single flat value; reviewer to model as a stacking or dynamic buff. ↻ RE-TRIGGERED 2026-09-17 (T1 tranche, `manual` retirement): `onCast skill`, 25s — the Seed of Skandha's lifetime (gcsim `skill.go` `AddStatus(skillMarkKey, 1500)`), the same window Tri-Karma's `armedFor` uses. gcsim's mod is permanent but returns nothing while no enemy is marked, so the Seed IS the window. Value 100 = one marked enemy, the tool's single-target frame.
constellations.description: When 1/2/3/4 (or more) nearby opponents are affected by All Schemes to Know's Seeds of Skandha, Nahida's Elemental Mastery will be increased by 100/120/140/160.

constellations.name: The Fruit of Reason's Culmination
_curatorNotes: EM scaling component not modeled: gcsim deals FlatDmg = snap.Stats[attributes.EM] * 4 (400% EM as flat additional damage) alongside the 200% ATK multiplier. The skeleton captures only the ATK scaling (scaling: 200, stat: 'atk'). Reviewer to add the EM flat-damage component once the schema supports FlatDmg expressions.

Trigger: inherited 'manual' needs reviewer replacement. gcsim: onNormalAttack or onChargeAttack hit on a Seed-marked enemy while c6ActiveKey status is present (10s window after Illusory Heart cast). ICD: 0.2s (12 frames) via c6ICDKey status. Proc cap: 6 instances per Illusory Heart window (c6Count tracked). Target scope: all Seed-marked enemies (multi-target). Reaction list needs KQM verification — game text uses vague phrasing.
constellations.description:
When Nahida hits an opponent affected by All Schemes to Know's Seeds of Skandha with Normal or Charged Attacks after unleashing Illusory Heart, she will use Tri-Karma Purification: Karmic Oblivion on this opponent and all connected opponents, dealing Dendro DMG based on 200% of Nahida's ATK and 400% of her Elemental Mastery.
DMG dealt by Tri-Karma Purification: Karmic Oblivion is considered Elemental Skill DMG and can be triggered once every 0.2s.
This effect can last up to 10s and will be removed after Nahida has unleashed 6 instances of Tri-Karma Purification: Karmic Oblivion.
